task: ae.columnar: encoded long-column segments with best-encoding selection, serialisation with strict validation, and a segmented Table with zone-map pruning
reasoning_summary: Designed five column encodings over a shared bit-packing primitive, with zone maps for pruning and a canonical, CRC-sealed serialised form that rejects every non-canonical image. Tests came first: literal layouts, randomised differential scans against a long[] oracle, exhaustive truncation/byte-flip tests, crafted re-sealed corrupt images with valid controls, and table queries against a naive row scan. Attempt 1 failed on one wrong expectation (a constant column is smaller as FOR width 0 than RLE); attempt 2 passed 31 tests, and a 20-mutant check found one real gap (FOR base-is-minimum rule) that was then covered.
